script:
Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
$d = Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly | Where-Object { $_.InstanceId -like 'SD\VID_02D0&PID_A9A6&FN_1*' } | Select-Object -First 1
"FN_1: status=" + $d.Status + " name=" + $d.FriendlyName
"service=" + (Get-PnpDeviceProperty -InstanceId $d.InstanceId -KeyName DEVPKEY_Device_Service).Data
"inf=" + (Get-PnpDeviceProperty -InstanceId $d.InstanceId -KeyName DEVPKEY_Device_DriverInfPath).Data
$root = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\SD\VID_02D0&PID_A9A6&FN_1'
$k = Get-ChildItem $root | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.PSPath 'Device Parameters' } | Select-Object -First 1
"probe Ver=" + (Get-ItemProperty $k).Ver
